prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1148; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this firm now represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection involving your insured. Effective immediately, all communication regarding this claim, including requests for statements, recorded interviews, and settlement discussions, must be directed to our office and not to our client.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and a statement confirming whether any other coverage may apply. Please also disclose the identity of any excess or umbrella carriers.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, claim file materials, adjuster notes, recorded statements, police correspondence, and any repair or total loss records for the vehicles involved. Any destruction or alteration of such material may result in sanctions. Please confirm in writing within ten days that these materials are being preserved.
